title: Synchronous tele-interpersonal psychotherapy versus tele-cognitive behavioural therapy for adults: which works better? Results from a randomised clinical trial.
quote: In community adults, t-IPT is as effective as t-CBT in treating symptoms of anxiety, depression or irritability.
summary: Ensaio randomizado com 149 adultos da comunidade: a terapia interpessoal online (t-IPT) teve efeito semelhante ao da TCC online (t-CBT) em ansiedade, depressão e irritabilidade.
